name: @algomaker/order-gateway
description: Consumes desk orders, splits under the exchange freeze limit, places via XTS, and writes real fills back.
_comment:desk-engine: Declared for the WIRE CONTRACT only — `ORDER_NUDGE_TOPIC`/`NudgePayload`, which `src/queue.ts` re-exports. The topic is a string this process and desk-api must AGREE on; it used to be declared here alone, which is exactly why desk-api never published it and every order waited out the idle sweep. Declared once in the contract module both sides import, and declared here as a dependency because an undeclared workspace import is one `npm install --workspace` away from a boot-time MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
